title: What is a class loader and what are the types?
shortTitle: What is a class loader and what are the types?
keyPoints: A class loader reads .class files and loads them into JVM memory
Bootstrap ClassLoader: loads core Java classes (java.lang, java.util) from rt.jar/modules
Platform ClassLoader (Extension): loads standard extensions (java.sql, javax packages)
Application ClassLoader: loads your application classes from the classpath
Custom class loaders: used by app servers, OSGi, and hot-deployment tools
Classes are loaded lazily – only when first referenced

s1_definition.oneliner: A class loader reads .class bytecode from disk and loads it into JVM memory. Three built-in loaders form a delegation chain: Bootstrap → Platform → Application.
s1_definition.profdef:
Three built-in class loaders:

- **Bootstrap ClassLoader:** Loads core JDK classes (java.lang.String, java.util.HashMap). Written in native code.
- **Platform ClassLoader (was Extension):** Loads standard library extensions.
- **Application ClassLoader:** Loads your application classes from the classpath (-cp or -classpath).
s1_definition.analogy: Loading bank procedures: the head office library (Bootstrap) provides core rules. The regional library (Platform) provides specialized procedures. The branch shelf (Application) holds your specific application code.

sections.s3_flow:
```text
  Class loading delegation chain:

  Application ClassLoader  (your classes)
    │ delegates to
    ▼
  Platform ClassLoader  (java.sql, javax)
    │ delegates to
    ▼
  Bootstrap ClassLoader  (java.lang, java.util)
    │
    ▼
  Found? → load. Not found? → parent not found → child tries → ClassNotFoundException
```
sections.s6_takeaway:
A class loader reads .class bytecode and loads it into JVM memory. Three built-in loaders form a chain: Bootstrap loads core JDK classes, Platform loads extensions, Application loads your code. Classes are loaded lazily on first use.

One sentence to remember: Bootstrap loads core Java, Platform loads extensions, Application loads your code – classes are loaded lazily on first use.
